meta.name: purple-cow-audit
meta.description: Score product remarkability 1-10 to decide if it's worth promoting. Seth Godin's Purple Cow test. Triggers on: "is this product worth promoting", "should I promote", "product audit", "purple cow", "remarkable product", "is it remarkable", "rate this product", "product quality check", "worth my reputation", "product evaluation", "would I recommend without commission", "product remarkability score", "evaluate this affiliate product", "quality gate for promotion".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为推广决策评估产品的可推荐性分数
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在推荐产品前判断它是否足够出彩、值得押上信誉。
copy.tagline_en: Score product remarkability to decide if it's worth promoting
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to decide whether a product is remarkable enough to promote before risking your reputation.

howto.what: Claude会分析你提到的产品，从独特性、质量、口碑等7个维度打分（1-10），综合后给出推荐：推广、有条件推广、谨慎或跳过，并指出产品的亮眼点和风险。
howto.when: 当你问“这个产品值得推广吗”、“产品审计”、“Purple Cow”等关键词，或想评估某个产品是否remarkable时触发。

say.note: Claude会对该产品进行评分并给出分析。
Claude会评估其是否值得作为Purple Cow推广。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes the product you mention, scores it 1-10 across 7 dimensions (uniqueness, quality, etc.), then recommends promote, promote with angle, caution, or skip, highlighting remarkable angles and red flags.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask "is this product worth promoting", "product audit", "purple cow", or similar keywords, or when you want to evaluate a product's remarkability.

say_en.note: Claude will score and analyze the product.
Claude evaluates if it's a Purple Cow worth promoting.
